replication.target_description: Interaction is SNS × nostalgia/control condition predicting felt arousal, not an arousal × SNS term predicting nostalgia ratings. High-arousal BANPS model: β=0.37, t(1675)=3.44, adjusted p<.01, f²=0.004; high-arousal TIPI model: β=0.35, t(1678)=3.37, adjusted p<.05, f²=0.004 (p.8). Table 11 p.17 gives exact adjusted p=.003 and .01, respectively. Low-arousal Table 12 p.19 gives SNS × condition β=0.13 and 0.10, both adjusted p>1. The locator does not choose covariate model or high/low arousal.

reported_success.quote: Nostalgia ﬁnding aligns with Barrett et al.’s (2010) ﬁnding, in which ... they observed tentative support for Trait Nostalgia to increase the ... potency of context-level effects.

notes: Identity verified independently: supplied text has matching title Unique Affective Profile of Music-Evoked Nostalgia: An Extension and Conceptual Replication of Barrett et al.’s (2010) Study, authors Sarah Hennessy, Timothy Greer, Shrikanth Narayanan, Assal Habibi, and DOI 10.1037/emo0001389. It is the primary research article (2024 advance online publication), with Methods, Results, Discussion, tables and references through printed p.23; not merely an abstract. No PDF was supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. The requested standardized beta is not established: context variables were raw and not standardized; person scores were mean-centered, not described as standardized. Printed β coefficients and Cohen’s f² candidates are retained without conversion. Interaction is SNS × nostalgia/control condition predicting felt arousal, not an arousal × SNS term predicting nostalgia ratings. High-arousal BANPS model: β=0.37, t(1675)=3.44, adjusted p<.01, f²=0.004; high-arousal TIPI model: β=0.35, t(1678)=3.37, adjusted p<.05, f²=0.004 (p.8). Table 11 p.17 gives exact adjusted p=.003 and .01, respectively. Low-arousal Table 12 p.19 gives SNS × condition β=0.13 and 0.10, both adjusted p>1. The locator does not choose covariate model or high/low arousal. Common candidate-model sample is explicitly N=582 participant clusters and 2,234 song observations. It is retained only as a candidate because row-to-test mapping is unresolved. Participants with improper responses (14) or no matched control songs (172) were excluded; unmatched song pairs were excluded. No N was inferred from df and no arithmetic sum was used.
